enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Rest head on the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Remain lying in bed with eyes closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Raise the hand to the light switch. Press the light switch on. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Bend forward. Splash water onto the face. Rub the face with both hands. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Turn on the tap. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Tap the toothbrush on the sink edge. Place the toothbrush back in the holder. Pick up the towel. Wipe the mouth. Hang the towel back. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Walk to the refrigerator. Pull the refrigerator door open. Take out the milk carton. Take out the bread. Take out two eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Walk out of the bedroom. Walk down the hallway. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the front door. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the bag. Walk down the stairs.
